_comment: The county (apskritis) of every single-mandate constituency name (issue #217), for the dashboard's grouped filter. Derived by scripts/build_constituency_counties.py, not by reading the names: VRK's own precinct list for each Seimas election, 1996-2024 (`sources`; published at https://www.vrk.lt/lt/rinkimu-apygardu-ir-apylinkiu-sarasas-ankstesniuose-rinkimuose), gives every precinct's district and municipality, and scraper/municipalities.json (#213) gives each municipality's county. `counties` is the union over every map the name was used in, in the registry's population order -- a name is not a boundary, and a district that touched two counties is listed under both; `maps` is the evidence, the municipalities and their precinct counts per general election (by-elections ran on their term's map). Names whose counties differ between maps are listed in `changedBetweenMaps`; the sharpest is Dainavos, a Kaunas city district through 2016 and the Prienai-Birštonas-Alytus district from 2020. Two precinct-list entries are read explicitly (the script's DISTRICT_NAMES and MUNICIPALITY_FORMS): 1996's Nr. 67 is 'Prienų' on the cards and 'Prienų–Birštono' in the list, and the 1996/2000 'Kupiškio rajonas' and 2004 bare 'Širvintų' are Kupiškis and Širvintai district. A name with an empty `counties` list has a `note` saying why; the filter groups it apart.

Pasaulio lietuvių.note: the district of voters abroad (2020 and 2024, Nr. 72): no precinct lies in Lithuania
